memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: The Lord said to Moses, "This applies to the Levites: Men twenty-five years old or more shall come to take part in the work at the tent of meeting, but at the age of fifty, they must retire from their regular service and work no longer. They may assist their brothers in performing their duties at the tent of meeting, but they themselves must not do the work. This, then, is how you are to assign the responsibilities of the Levites." - Num 8:23-26 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
God set boundaries around the Levites' service: they began their regular work at twenty-five, and at fifty they stepped back from the heavy duties. But notice — they did not simply stop being useful. After fifty, they could still "assist their brothers." There was a season for full active service, and a season for supporting and guiding others.

This is full of wisdom and grace. God did not expect the Levites to carry the heaviest load forever. There is a time for vigorous frontline service, and a time to step back and let younger ones carry the weight, while offering experience, encouragement, and help.

How freeing this is for us. We are not meant to run at full pace forever, and there is no shame in a changing season. The older Levites were not cast aside as useless; their role simply shifted from doing to helping, from carrying to guiding. Their wisdom and presence were still valued.

This speaks to every stage of life. If you are in a season of full strength, serve wholeheartedly while you can. If you are in a season of stepping back, know that you are not finished — your experience, prayers, and encouragement are a gift to those coming behind you.

God has meaningful work for every season of life. Whether you are carrying the load or cheering on those who do, you have a place in His purposes. Serve faithfully in the season you are in.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- What season of service are you in right now?
- If you are slowing down, how can you still help and encourage others?
- How can you value both the energy of the young and the wisdom of the older?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, thank You that You have meaningful work for every season of life. Help me to serve faithfully now, and to bless those coming after me. Amen.
